opens the first storefront never lands here. It carries no Where, so it opens in any world and follows
Santa wherever a server stands him: players reach it through his conversation, and Season closes it

the header: the game's Christmas Packets, to wrap gifts in, and candy canes. Includes carries the
festival shelf (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Festival_Stall) beside his own goods: the offers every season's host
shares, priced in festival tokens, with one purchase limit across them all, each on sale only in its
own Season or Dates (so the winter pieces show here). The shelf brings its own wallet, place and name.
